newsitem.title: USA: AccuStaff buys Computer Systems Development.
newsitem.headline: AccuStaff buys Computer Systems Development.

text.p: AccuStaff Inc said Thursday it has bought Computer Systems Development of America Inc for an undisclosed price.

The company said the transaction is expected to be accretive to earnings. The First Call consensus estimates for AccuStaff's 1997 earnings are $0.22 per share for the June second quarter and $0.96 for the year.
Privately owned Computer Systems had 1996 sales of more than $20 million, AccuStaff said.
The addition of Computer Systems gives AccuStaff its first presence in the United Kingdom, it said. Computer Systems has offices in New York, Dallas, Orlando and London.
